concept: A high school girl who can hear thoughts falls for the only boy she cannot read.
story_outline: Hana discovers that she can hear everyone else's thoughts except Kaito's. As she grows closer to him, she learns he is carrying a supernatural burden. Their relationship reaches an emotional turning point on the school rooftop at sunset.

primary_characters.name: Hana
primary_characters.description: 16-year-old girl with short brown hair, amber eyes, and a school uniform

primary_characters.name: Kaito
primary_characters.description: 17-year-old transfer student with dark hair and a guarded expression
